name: Macompta.fr
summary: Macompta.fr delivers web-based software solutions designed for both businesses and non-profit organizations. Through its Software as a Service (SaaS) model, the company offers critical functions such as financial accounting, tax declaration assistance, invoicing, and payroll administration. Users gain secure, device-agnostic access to their data, requiring only an internet connection. Established in 2007, this firm is headquartered in Lagord, France.
